name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
license: varies by build; Mia's scripts are AGPL

architecture.anatomy: 125B experts + 51B embedding lookup table + 4B MTP head

summary: The flagship, and the reason single-box builds exist at all. Base weights are datacenter-only at 360GB BF16. Every single-Spark build shares one trick: the 51GB embedding lookup table stays on disk and is fetched line by line (mmap with MADV_RANDOM), so only about 72GB sits resident. Builders then differ in engine, whether vision survives, and how honest they are about the quality cost.
fit_note: About 15GB of headroom left on a 128GB Spark once resident. It sleeps by the edge: concurrency, context length and KV dtype all have to be tuned down, and a mis-set memory fraction can hard-reboot the box.

practical_baseline.rationale: Most accessible sourced stable 4-bit lane: one consumer GPU with explicitly recorded host-RAM offload and single-stream decode.
